notes.title: The "Sea and mountains" update is now available
notes.notes:
[h3]In this extension you will build a railway net on a large map with a mountain range and several rivers. If you like long train trips, this map is for you.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35673540/707723db10ce827f7a37e79fa300cd0557f64e71.png[/img]
[h3]The map shows 31 passenger and 9 cargo stations.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35673540/0f140fde8f8f5dcec4aa9591025efe0ca850aa48.png[/img]
[h3]The region is divided into two parts by a mountain range. You can build mountain train tunnels to connect both parts.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35673540/426d9574905153baf8f47e71c00db7370d27d953.png[/img]
[h3]An exciting journey in picturesque mountain scenery along a sea shore is waiting for you.[/h3]

[h3]Follow the link to take a look at the DLC:[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2674430/My_Train_Arrives__Sea_and_mountains/
[h3]Write what you think about the DLC. I will be glad to read your comments.
I hope you will like the DLC![/h3]

notes.title: The "In ten years" update is now available.
notes.notes:
[h3]Take a look at your favorite cities in ten years. 8 cities from the original campaign will be available in this extension. City boundaries expanded significantly. The game area increased by 65%. New passenger and cargo stations appeared in all cities. New roads, bridges, stadiums, residential areas, and such industrial facilities as plants and harbors were built on the outskirts of the cities.[/h3]

notes.title: The "Big cities" update is now available.
notes.notes:
[h3]You will be able to create a railroad network on two big maps.[/h3]


[h2]Two cities[/h2]

[h3]On the map Two Cities you will construct a railroad network between cities situated on banks of rivers that flow into the sea. 
The map has 30 passenger stations and 14 goods stations.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35673540/3835d818cc896ccbef7dbc624306e96a48682c21.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35673540/ab77a6092125e9e678fae82d5c1e0907aaac6830.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35673540/106d38e9532701008ccf0117612b32d2820c60bc.png[/img]


[h2]City and countryside[/h2]

[h3]On the map City and Countryside you will be able to develop transport connections between a big oceanfront city and its suburbs. 
The city has 24 passenger stations and 14 goods stations.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35673540/fc14aed57299758319a68b424382884981fb5b3b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35673540/9c49a2a751dabcede7e2ea95924a822e76107c50.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35673540/71ed9e0f17c68ec3aad5290ec984058ef72addb9.png[/img]

[h3]Each map is two and a half times bigger than the biggest city in the Campaign mode.[/h3]

[h3]Follow the link to take a look at the DLC:[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1572030/My_Train_Arrives__Big_cities/

[h3]Write what you think about the DLC. I will be glad to read your comments.
I hope you will like the DLC![/h3]

notes.title: A new update of the game is released
notes.notes:
[h3]
- You can select the difficulty for the Campaign mode. If you choose easy difficulty in the settings you will have more time to complete a Campaign.

- Prices for upgrades and research of unique trains are changed. If you play on normal difficulty, the prices will be much lower.

- 7 music tracks were added.[/h3]

notes.title: The update of the game with a new city is already available
notes.notes:
A new city is added.
The models of cities are improved.
The display of water and shadows is improved.
Some minor flaws in graphics were eliminated.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35673540/3ea276f269c8011df31e2bdbe007cd7646df4f34.png[/img]

notes.title: A new update is available
notes.notes:
1. Save and load functions were added.
2. You can now get a refund for deleting tracks.
If you haven’t created a route yet, you can refund 100% of the track price (in case you built a track by mistake). 
Otherwise you will get a 50% refund.
3. Some minor mistakes were fixed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35673540/14d9d8ae7109c953ed21233449c875641296ba58.png[/img]
